# Odyssey — run log

2026-09-20 · odyssey-001 · 1.1–95 · pilot, made in an attended session and approved by the owner the same day · 51 units, 473 glossary forms · review: 11 high, 17 medium, 12 low, all applied · scansion: 95 of 95 lines fit; 1.40 flagged (final -ο of Ὀρέσταο counts long before τίσις) and said so in the note.

2026-09-22 · odyssey-002 · 1.96–212 · unattended routine run, drafter/reviewer on the strongest model, glosser on Sonnet · 64 units, 479 new glossary forms (952 total), 15 broadened · review pass 1–2 (translation): 13 error, 9 minor, 14 refused — the one publication-stopping error was a wrongly-claimed open speech: Athena's reply (179–212) actually closes inside this part, answered by Telemachus at 1.213, not left running into odyssey-003 as first drafted; also six false "unaugmented" labels (the drafter's systematic weak spot, several inside compounds), a wrong mood label, two misdirected cross-references into odyssey-001 · review pass 3 (glossary): 494 entries checked (all of them), 13 fixed — two lemma errors (τά, τοῖσίν put under the relative instead of the article-pronoun), a wrong tense (future not present mid.), a wrong gender, an invented ending, and similar — all 15 broadenings verified to extend the existing entry verbatim, never replace it · scansion: 117 of 117 lines fit, none flagged · 20 new fixed renderings added to conventions.md's house table (ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα "winged words", a third reply-formula distinct from the two already fixed, οἶνοψ πόντος deliberately not "wine-dark", and others) · build and validate both clean on the first try after the fixes.

2026-09-22 · odyssey-003 · 1.213–324 · unattended routine run, drafter/reviewer on the strongest model, glosser on Sonnet; units pre-cut from the edition by a script (t/ln/p fixed before drafting, no retyping) · 65 units, 361 new glossary forms (1313 total), 17 broadened · review pass 1 (translation): 3 error, 8 minor, 15 refused — errors were a wrong claim about caesura placement, a note contradicting its own `l` ("dear heart" vs. the note's own "own heart"), and an `about` slip giving Athena's own father (Zeus) as the giver of the poison instead of the father of her Mentes disguise; augment labelling (last part's weak spot) was clean this time, all 30 labels correct including 7 augmented-inside-a-compound forms; all six speech boundaries and all three fixed-English repeats (matching odyssey-001 and odyssey-002) verified correct as drafted · review pass 2 (glossary): all 378 entries checked, 20 fixed (4 error: a wrong gender, a wrong case, an overbroad breathing rule, and ἤρατ’ relemmatised from the disputed ἄρνυμαι to ἀείρω per LSJ's actual filing; 16 minor) · scansion: 112 of 112 lines fit, none flagged · 14 new fixed renderings added to conventions.md's house table (a fourth reply-formula distinct from the three already fixed, πεπνυμένος "prudent", θεῶν ἐν γούνασι κεῖται, ἰσόθεος φώς, and others) plus 9 new proper names · two open decisions written to QUESTIONS.md: the glossary's 230-character cap blocks adding τῷ's inferential "therefore" sense at 1.239, and 1.277's ἔεδνα/οἱ δέ reading is left without a hedge in the note · build and validate both clean on the first try after the fixes.

2026-09-23 · odyssey-004 · 1.325–444 · unattended routine run, drafter/reviewer on the strongest model, glosser on Sonnet · 68 units, 384 new glossary forms (1697 total), 1 broadened (ὄφρα — the shipped entry covered only the purposive sense; this part uses it temporally, "until" + indicative, so the old entry was kept whole and the new reading appended) · review pass 1 (translation): 1 major, 5 moderate, 2 minor, ~15 findings considered and refused — the major finding was a factual slip in a note, misattributing the Ethiopians'-feast scene (1.22–26) to Zeus when it is Poseidon; the moderate/minor fixes were an `l`/`i` disagreement on θέσπιν ἀοιδήν colliding with the θεῖος/δῖος distinction, a missing closing quotation mark at the end of Penelope's speech (1.343), a mislabelled pronoun (demonstrative τοῦ called "possessive"), a dative-of-comparison rendered so it read as accompaniment instead (1.432), an unverifiable line-28 quotation and an unverifiable hapax claim both trimmed from notes, and a mislabelled "potential optative" corrected to "optative of wish" · all 7 marked speeches (Penelope, Telemachus ×4, Antinous, Eurymachus) verified for correct quote-mark placement; 1.345's ratified English (from odyssey-003) reused verbatim; the two in-part repeats (1.388=1.412, 1.428=1.434) given identical English · review pass 2 (glossary): all 384 novel entries and all 220 known-form usages checked; 1 broadening found (ὄφρα, above), the rest already covered by their shipped entries · scansion: 120 of 120 lines fit, none flagged · 8 new fixed renderings added to conventions.md's house table: ἀμφίαλος Ἰθάκη "sea-girt Ithaca", δῖα γυναικῶν (parallel to δῖα θεάων), θεῖος (of a minstrel) "divine", περίφρων Πηνελόπεια "circumspect Penelope", two new name-and-patronymic reply-formulas (Antinous, Eurymachus), κεδνὰ ἰδυῖα (of Eurycleia), and the repeated αἰθομένας δαΐδας φέρε · one open decision written to QUESTIONS.md: how strictly to read the "asserts nothing about the rest of the poem" note rule — decided on the narrower reading (bar unverifiable/specific claims, allow broad thematic framing), matching odyssey-001's own model notes · build and validate both clean on the first try after the review fixes.

2026-09-23 · odyssey-005 · 2.1–102 · unattended routine run, drafter/reviewer on the strongest model, glosser on Sonnet · 64 units, 299 new glossary forms (1996 total), 12 broadened (3 of the 9 glosser broadenings corrected by the reviewer, plus 3 new broadenings — οἷος, ἐξ οὗ, κεῖται-as-subjunctive — the reviewer added on top of the glosser's 9) · review pass 1 (translation): 1 major, 5 moderate, ~13 minor, several findings considered and refused — the major finding was a misconstrual at 2.28–29 (τίνα χρειὼ τόσον ἵκει), where the draft wrongly took τίνα as agreeing with χρειώ ("what need...") when τίνα is the accusative object and χρειώ the subject ("whom has so great a need come upon?"); moderate fixes included a wrong line-position claim (πάγχυ/πάμπαν), two false "unaugmented" labels (ἔκτανε, ἐπέχραον — both are augmented), and ἄσχετος wrongly equated with its near-opposite ἀνάσχετος · review pass 2 (glossary): all 299 novel entries and all 9 broadenings checked, 17 novel entries corrected (wrong lemma headwords per LSJ, gender mismatches, mislabelled diectasis vs. plain uncontraction, an over-length broadening) and 5 broadenings corrected · speech structure: three speeches — Aegyptius (2.25–34, closed), Telemachus (2.40–79, closed), Antinous (2.85–end, deliberately left open into odyssey-006), with Penelope's own words quoted in single quotes inside Antinous's speech (2.96–102); the closing point of Penelope's inner quote at 2.102 was checked by hand against the Greek (μιν/κτεατίσσας are masculine, referring to Laertes, so the sentence is still hers) and confirmed correct · scansion: 102 of 102 lines fit, none flagged · validator WARN (expected and confirmed, not a defect): 3 opening vs. 2 closing quotation marks in both `l` and `i`, because Antinous's speech is not closed within this part and continues into odyssey-006 · 28 new fixed renderings added to conventions.md's house table (the dawn-formula line, a new "set out to go" formula, κύνες ἀργοί flagged as disputed swift/white, αἶθοψ οἶνος built like the table's οἶνοψ πόντος, ὑψαγόρη, τανηλεγής flagged as of unknown meaning, and others) · three open decisions written to QUESTIONS.md: whether ASCII or typographic apostrophes should be the house rule across `l`/`i`/`n` (published parts 001–003 use ASCII, 004 uses typographic, and this part follows 001–003's practice since the rule was never settled); the published odyssey-glossary.json entry for ἔβη is mislabelled "unaugmented" (it is the augmented form; entries are additions-only, so this could not be fixed in place); and whether ὑψαγόρην at 1.385 (odyssey-004) matches this part's rendering at 2.85 (not checked, since the reviewer was scoped to only the last few units of odyssey-004) · build and validate both clean on the first try after the review fixes.

2026-09-23 · odyssey-006 · 2.103–207 · unattended routine run, drafter/reviewer on the strongest model, glosser on Sonnet · 63 units, 252 new glossary forms (2248 total), 8 broadened (πάρος, πολλά, ἂν, ἄπο, ἅπαντα, περικαλλέα, ὄφρα, ὅ — all verified to keep the old entry whole) · review pass 1 (translation, two sub-passes): 0 error, 9 moderate, 19 minor — moderate fixes included two false "unaugmented" labels (ἔληθε/ἔπειθεν, ἔτεχ’ — both augmented), ἡώς "Dawn" wrongly substituted for ἥρως "hero" at 2.157, a misattributed line-repeat note (2.161 wrongly credited to "Antinous at 2.85" instead of the actual source, Aegyptius at 2.25), a note on ἔεδνα (2.196) that silently dropped the direction-of-gifts dispute already flagged in odyssey-003's and odyssey-005's own notes on the same word, and a naming collision between the drafter's proposed πολύμητις rendering and the house table's πολύφρων (fixed to "many-wiled") · review pass 2 (glossary): all 252 novel entries checked, 2 corrected (ἔειπε mislabelled "reduplicated" — it is the augment kept uncontracted before the root's own ει-, not reduplication; εἰσανέβαινον mislabelled "unaugmented" — the elided α of its preverb ἀνα- only elides because the augment is there) · one further lemma fix made at publish-time review: κεχολωμένον relemmatised from χολόομαι to χολόω, LSJ's actual headword for the family · speech structure: Antinous's speech (open from odyssey-005) closes at 2.128; Telemachus speaks 2.130–145 (closed); the eagle-omen scene follows (no speech); Halitherses speaks 2.161–176 (closed) — his opening line is itself a repeat of Aegyptius's opening at 2.25 in odyssey-005, reused verbatim; Eurymachus speaks 2.178–207, deliberately left open into odyssey-007, the last unit's note stating so plainly · all eight claimed line-repeats against odyssey-003/004/005 verified character-for-character identical · scansion: 105 of 105 lines fit, none flagged · validator: clean PASS, zero WARN (opening/closing quotation-mark counts balance within this part itself, since the speech left open from odyssey-005 and the speech left open into odyssey-007 offset each other) · 7 new fixed renderings added to conventions.md's house table (ἐυπλοκαμῖδες, ἐυστέφανος, ἐυδείελος flagged as disputed etymology, εὐρύοπα Ζεύς flagged as disputed, πολύμητις "many-wiled" kept distinct from πολυμήχανος and πολύφρων, υἷες Ἀχαιῶν, μνηστὺς ἀργαλέη) · one open decision restated and one new one written to QUESTIONS.md · build and validate both clean on the first try after the review fixes.
